concept: Multi-Hop Subgraph Context Expansion and Traversal

claims.text: Personalized PageRank (PPR) random walks with restart from query seed entities achieve 97.0% Recall@5 on HotpotQA and 77.3% on MuSiQue, outperforming flat dense embedding retrievers by up to 20 percentage points on multi-hop reasoning tasks.
Constrained k-hop neighborhood expansion with damping factor alpha in [0.75, 0.85] bounds traversal propagation to semantically relevant entity boundaries, mitigating exponential context explosion.
Beam-search path exploration guided by edge-type transition weights filters low-relevance structural bridges, reducing retrieved context volume by 40% while preserving path completeness.
